scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run db:check && npm test && npm run build

ADMIN_EMAIL.description: The email address of the person who sets up and owns this Huddle. After deploying, open Huddle and sign in with it, the **setup key** below and an authenticator app.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: At least **32 random letters and numbers** that nobody else knows. It protects sign-ins and is your **setup key** for the first sign-in; keep a copy somewhere safe (changing it later signs everyone out).

APP_URL.description: Leave **empty**: Huddle uses the address it's opened at. Set it only once you give Huddle its own domain, e.g. `https://chat.example.com`.

GMAIL_ADDRESS.description: Optional. A Gmail address to send invitations and email summaries from (a dedicated one like `acme.huddle@gmail.com` is best). Without email, people sign in with an authenticator app.

GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD.description: Optional. An **app password** for that Gmail (Google account › Security › 2-Step Verification on › App passwords).

EMAIL_FROM.description: Optional. The name shown on emails, e.g. `Acme Huddle <x@example.com>` (only the name is used).

GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID.description: Optional, leave empty: only for a "Sign in with Google" button.

GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional, leave empty: only for a "Sign in with Google" button.

DB.description: The database for messages, people and settings.

FILES.description: Private storage for files people share.
